papers.title: Development of digestive system learning application based on discovery learning assisted by augmented reality
papers.abstract: Background: The COVID-19 pandemic has caused changes in every sector of life, including the field of education. In addition, students still have difficulty understanding biological concepts in depth during the learning process. This indicates that students' critical thinking skills in biology learning are still low. Objective: The objective of this research is to determine the feasibility and effectiveness level of Augmented Reality (AR) media based on Discovery Learning (DL) on the digestive system material in enhancing students' critical thinking skills and collaboration abilities. Model: This study uses the ADDIE development model. The study was conducted at State Senior High School 1 Srandakan-Yogyakarta, with field trial subjects consisting of 60 students from two classes selected using the cluster random sampling technique. Results: The research results show that the AR media based on DL the digestive system material is deemed suitable for use based on expert assessments, very practical based on the evaluations of biology teachers and students, and effective in enhancing students' critical thinking skills and collaboration abilities based on the MANOVA test results with a significance value of 0.016 (p < 0.05). Conclusion: AR media based on DL can be used as an innovative learning medium to enhance students' critical thinking and collaboration skills in biology education.
papers.summary_zh:
【金融经济学】**背景**：COVID-19大流行对生活的各个领域都产生了影响，包括教育领域。此外，学生在学习过程中仍然难以深入理解生物学概念，这表明他们在生物学学习中的批判性思维能力较低。  
**目的**：本研究旨在探讨基于发现学习（Discovery Learning, DL）的增强现实（Augmented Reality, AR）技术在消化系统教学中的应用可行性及其对提升学生批判性思维能力和合作能力的有效性。  
**研究模型**：本研究采用了ADDIE开发模型。实验在日惹Srandakan市的第一州立高中进行，研究对象为通过集群随机抽样方法选取的两个班级共60名学生。  
**研究结果**：专家评估表明，基于发现学习的AR教学资源适用于消化系统教学；生物学教师和学生的反馈也显示该技术具有很高的实用性；同时，MANOVA测试结果（显著性值p<0.05）表明该技术能有效提升学生的批判性思维能力和合作能力。  
**结论**：基于发现学习的AR教学资源可作为创新的学习工具，有效提升学生在生物学教育中的批判性思维能力和合作能力。。

papers.title: Individual identification and confirmation of nest site fidelity in painted stork ( Mycteria leucocephala ) using deep transfer learning
papers.abstract:
Abstract
                  Accurate individual identification is vital in field studies. Since traditional marking techniques, though effective, can be intrusive and obtaining permits can be difficult, identification using natural markings has gained popularity across various taxa as a non-invasive alternative. Here, we report on a painted stork (Mycteria leucocephala) with a distinctive neck injury mark, observed at the Delhi Zoo, India, over four consecutive breeding seasons (2022–2025). To verify its identity and assess nest-site fidelity, we employed a non-invasive approach that combined traditional (morphometrics, scale-invariant feature transform (SIFT)) and advanced techniques (deep transfer learning (DTL)). High-resolution photographs were used to extract linear measurements and assess the repeatability of features by SIFT, while a DTL classifier further validated the individual’s identity with 98% accuracy, confirming the classification decision through an explainable artificial intelligence technique (Gradient-weighted Class Activation Mapping). Image-based morphometric measurements were particularly reliable for longer morphological features and classification based on wing feathers’ colour patterns, confirming that the scar-marked stork observed over four consecutive years is indeed the same individual. The repeated sightings of the scar-marked stork on the same site support evidence of nest-site fidelity. Our findings highlight the potential of pattern-based recognition and DTL as powerful, non-intrusive tools for long-term monitoring of colonial waterbirds.
papers.summary_zh:
【公司金融】摘要  
在野外研究中，准确识别个体至关重要。尽管传统的标记方法虽然有效，但可能存在侵入性，且获取相关许可较为困难；因此，利用自然体表特征进行个体识别已成为一种非侵入性的替代方案，被广泛应用于多种生物类群的研究中。本文报道了一只印度德里动物园中观察到的白头鹳（Mycteria leucocephala），该鹳在连续四个繁殖季节（2022–2025年）内都带有明显的颈部伤痕。为验证其身份并评估其筑巢地点的稳定性，我们采用了一种结合传统方法（形态测量、尺度不变特征变换（SIFT）与先进技术（深度迁移学习（DTL））的非侵入性研究方法。通过高分辨率照片提取线性测量数据，并利用SIFT技术评估特征的可重复性；随后，DTL分类器以98%的准确率确认了该个体的身份，这一结果通过可解释的人工智能技术（梯度加权类激活映射，Gradient-weighted Class Activation Mapping）得到了进一步验证。基于图像的形态测量方法对于较长形态特征的识别尤为可靠，尤其是通过翅膀羽毛的颜色模式进行分类时；这些证据表明，连续四年观察到的这只带有伤痕的鹳确实是同一只个体。该鹳在同一筑巢地...。

papers.title: Robust quasi-convex risk measures and applications
papers.abstract: This paper develops a unified framework for the robustification of risk measures beyond the classical convex and cash-additive setting. We consider general risk measures on Lp spaces and construct their robust counterparts through families of uncertainty sets that capture ambiguity. Two complementary mechanisms generate robust quasi-convex measures: in the first, quasi-convexity is inherited from the initial risk measure under convex uncertainty sets; in the second it comes from the quasi-convex (or c-quasi-convex) structure of the uncertainty sets themselves. Building on Cerreia-Vioglio et al. (2011); Frittelli and Maggis (2011), we derive dual (penalty-type) representations for robust quasi-convex and cash-subadditive risk measures, showing that the classical convex cash-additive case arises as a special instance. We further analyze acceptance families and capital allocation rules under robustification, highlighting how ambiguity affects acceptability and the distribution of capital.
papers.summary_zh: 【风险管理与衍生品】本文提出了一个统一的框架，用于在传统凸风险度量和现金可加性框架之外对风险度量进行鲁棒化处理。我们考虑了在Lp空间上的通用风险度量，并通过一系列能够捕捉不确定性的不确定性集合来构建这些风险度量的鲁棒对应形式。两种互补的机制产生了鲁棒准凸风险度量：在第一种机制中，准凸性是从初始风险度量在凸不确定性集合下的性质继承而来的；在第二种机制中，准凸性则来源于不确定性集合本身的准凸（或c-准凸）结构。基于Cerreia-Vioglio（2011）和Frittelli与Maggis（2011）的研究成果，我们推导出了鲁棒准凸风险度量和现金次可加风险度量的对偶（惩罚型）表示形式，证明了传统凸现金可加情况是这些鲁棒度量的一个特例。此外，我们还分析了鲁棒化条件下的接受度集合和资本分配规则，强调了不确定性如何影响风险的可接受性以及资本的分配方式。。

papers.title: Workers' Incentives and the Optimal Taxation of AI
papers.abstract: We characterize the optimal tax policy in an economy with human manual and cognitive labor, physical capital, and artificial intelligence (AI). Extending the dynamic taxation setup of Slavik and Yazici (2014), we find that it is optimal to start taxing AI when cognitive workers start to consider switching to manual jobs. This threshold may be crossed once AI becomes sufficiently capable in substituting humans across cognitive tasks.
papers.summary_zh: 【金融经济学】我们研究了在一个包含人力劳动、认知劳动、物质资本以及人工智能（AI）的经济体中，最优税收政策的特征。在Slavik和Yazici（2014）提出的动态税收模型的基础上，我们发现当认知型劳动者开始考虑转而从事体力劳动时，对AI征税才是最合适的时机。这一临界点可能出现在AI在替代人类完成认知任务方面具备足够能力的时候。。

papers.title: Checkpoint Intensity and Firm Productivity: Long-Term Economic Effects in the West Bank
papers.venue: Journal of economics, finance and management studies
papers.abstract: This paper examines the long-term economic impact of movement restrictions in the form of checkpoint intensity on private sector productivity in the West Bank. Drawing on a conceptual production framework and calibrated sectoral simulations, the study analyzes how transaction costs, labor market frictions, capital accumulation delays, information asymmetries, and security-related uncertainty affect firm-level total factor productivity. A structured empirical strategy combining sectoral data and exposure-based variation is used to evaluate productivity differentials across manufacturing, services, tourism, and rural enterprises. The results suggest that sustained checkpoint intensity is associated with persistent productivity gaps, particularly among export-oriented firms and geographically peripheral enterprises. Calibrated long-run growth projections indicate that cumulative output losses may range between 10–15 percent over extended horizons. The findings highlight the economic trade-off between short-term security considerations and long-term growth potential and underscore the role of infrastructure and administrative reforms in partially mitigating productivity losses.
papers.summary_zh: 【公司金融】本文研究了以检查站设置强度为形式的移动限制对西岸私营部门生产力的长期经济影响。基于一个概念性的生产框架和经过校准的部门模拟模型，该研究分析了交易成本、劳动力市场摩擦、资本积累延迟、信息不对称以及与安全相关的不确定性如何影响企业层面的全要素生产率。研究采用了一种结合部门数据和基于暴露程度差异的实证分析方法，来评估制造业、服务业、旅游业及农村企业之间的生产力差异。研究结果表明，持续的检查站设置强度会导致生产率差距长期存在，尤其是在以出口为导向的企业和地理位置较为偏远的企业中。经过校准的长期增长预测显示，在较长的时间范围内，累计产出损失可能达到10%至15%。研究结果强调了短期安全考虑与长期增长潜力之间的经济权衡，并指出了基础设施和行政改革在部分缓解生产力损失方面所起的作用。。研究方法：数值模拟。

papers.title: Can Banking Intermediates Crowd Out Their High‐Tech Promising Successors? A Financial Stress Perspective
papers.abstract: This study looks into the dynamic nexus of financial stress with major US banks and major high‐tech firms that aspire to be their successors. Using weekly data from 3 January 2017 to 20 September 2024 and the Quantile‐VAR (QVAR) framework, the net pairwise directional connectedness, the extended joint connectedness, and the dynamic network nexus are examined. Findings reveal that technology giants are far more closely linked to financial stress than banks, and this is even more profound in bear markets and, even in bull markets, due to high inflation and geopolitical instability, which intensifies when new wars break out. This is the first study that employs the Financial Stress Index and the QVAR model to detect and measure the size of impacts that financial conditions exert under inflationary pressures on financial disintermediation and the transition to the new cashless economy. This informs policymakers and investors that tech giants will play a bigger role in the financial system when new crises arise, and they will gradually push to replace or merge with systemic banks.
papers.summary_zh: 【银行与信贷】本研究探讨了美国主要银行与那些渴望成为其继任者的科技巨头之间的动态关联。研究使用了2017年1月3日至2024年9月20日的每周数据，并运用分位数向量自回归（Quantile-VAR, QVAR）框架，分析了银行与科技巨头之间的净双向关联性、扩展的联合关联性以及动态网络结构。研究结果表明，科技巨头与金融压力的关联程度远高于银行；在熊市中这种关联更为紧密，而在牛市中，由于高通胀和地缘政治不稳定（尤其是在新的战争爆发时），这种关联会进一步加剧。这是首次运用金融压力指数（Financial Stress Index）和QVAR模型来检测和衡量在通胀压力下金融状况对金融中介功能以及向无现金经济转型过程的影响程度。研究结果提醒政策制定者和投资者：在新的危机出现时，科技巨头将在金融体系中发挥更重要的作用，并可能逐渐取代或与系统性银行合并。。研究方法：向量自回归。

papers.title: Deep Learning Projects Jurisdiction of New and Proposed Clean Water Act Regulation -- by Simon Greenhill, Brant J. Walker, Joseph S. Shapiro
papers.abstract: Projecting the effects of proposed policy reforms is challenging because no outcome data exist for regulations that governments have not yet implemented. We propose an ex ante deep learning framework that can project effects of proposed reforms by mapping outcomes observed under past regulations onto the legal criteria of proposed future policies (i.e., by “relabeling”). We apply this framework to study changes in jurisdiction of the US Clean Water Act (CWA). We compare our ex ante deep learning projection of jurisdiction under the Supreme Court’s Sackett decision against widely used projections from domain experts. Ex ante machine learning generates exceptional performance improvements over the leading domain expert model that the US Environmental Protection Agency currently uses, with 65 times more accurate identification of jurisdictional sites. We also develop an ex post deep learning model trained with data after policy implementation. Ex post deep learning performs best. Sackett deregulates one-third of all previously regulated US waters, particularly floodplains and pristine fish habitats, totaling 700,000 deregulated stream miles and 17 million deregulated wetland acres. Deep learning can effectively project consequences of far-reaching regulatory reforms before they are implemented, when projections are both most uncertain and most useful.
papers.summary_zh: 【绿色金融与可持续发展】预测拟议政策改革的效果具有挑战性，因为对于政府尚未实施的法规，目前还缺乏相应的结果数据。我们提出了一种事前的深度学习框架，该框架通过将过去法规下的实际结果映射到未来拟议政策的法律标准上来（即通过“重新标注”），从而预测这些改革的效果。我们应用这一框架研究了《美国清洁水法》（CWA）管辖范围的变化。我们将基于事前深度学习模型对最高法院Sackett裁决下管辖范围变化的预测结果，与领域专家们广泛使用的预测结果进行了比较。与目前美国环境保护署所使用的领先领域专家模型相比，事前深度学习模型在预测准确性上取得了显著提升，其识别管辖区域的准确率提高了65倍。此外，我们还开发了一个基于政策实施后数据的事后深度学习模型，该模型在预测效果上表现最佳。根据Sackett裁决，美国三分之一的受监管水域被解除管制，主要包括洪泛区和原始鱼类栖息地，涉及70万英里的河流和1700万英亩的湿地。深度学习能够在具有高度不确定性的同时，有效预测具有深远影响的监管改革所带来的后果——而这正是这些预测最为关键和有用的阶段。。研究方法：机器学习、深度学习。

papers.title: We've Got You Covered: Firms' Political Stances on Abortion and Labor Market Sorting -- by Pawel Adrjan, Svenja Gudell, Emily E. Nix, Allison Shrivastava, Jason Sockin, Evan P. Starr
papers.abstract: Amidst rising political polarization, firms engage more frequently with political issues through public statements and policies. This paper examines how firms' stances on polarizing issues impact worker sorting, leveraging announcements from hundreds of employers following the Supreme Court's ruling in Dobbs v. Jackson, overturning federal abortion rights. We introduce a methodology to uncover labor market competitors for each announcing firm based on job seekers' revealed preferences. While announcing firms received more applications from job seekers, particularly in Democratic-leaning states and female-dominated jobs where abortion was outlawed, current employees began searching for jobs elsewhere as employee satisfaction declined, particularly among male-dominated jobs. Smaller companies with less-established reputations experienced the largest effects. When deciding whether to take a sociopolitical stance, firms face a complicated trade-off: attracting culturally-aligned workers at the expense of alienating current ones.
papers.summary_zh: 【公司金融】在政治两极分化日益严重的背景下，企业更频繁地通过公开声明和政策参与政治议题的讨论。本文研究了企业在具有争议性议题上的立场如何影响劳动力的分配情况，研究数据来源于最高法院在“多布斯诉杰克逊案”（Dobbs v. Jackson）中推翻联邦堕胎权利裁决后数百家企业的公开声明。我们采用了一种方法论，根据求职者的偏好来识别每家企业的劳动力市场竞争对手。虽然发布声明的企业收到了更多求职者的申请，尤其是在倾向于民主党的地区以及堕胎被禁止的女性主导的工作岗位中，但现有员工的满意度却下降了，尤其是在男性主导的工作岗位中，这导致他们开始另寻工作。声誉较低的小型企业受到的影响最为显著。企业在决定是否采取某种社会政治立场时面临着一个复杂的权衡：一方面可以吸引与自身文化理念相符的求职者，另一方面可能会疏远现有的员工。。

papers.title: Towards Measuring Disruptive Innovation Across Countries
papers.abstract: The CD index is a widely used measure of disruptive inventions. Most studies compute it using USPTO data. This creates a puzzle because the US appears less disruptive than European and Asian countries. We show that this largely stems from missing international citations. Using a global citation network, we quantify and correct this bias. The disruptiveness advantage of non-US inventors drops by 64% to 148% of the US baseline mean. The US emerges as a disruption leader over Europe, with Asia's advantage substantially reduced. Globally integrated citation data are essential for credible measurement of disruptive innovation in international contexts.
papers.summary_zh: 【金融经济学】CD指数是衡量颠覆性创新的一个广泛使用的指标。大多数研究使用美国专利商标局（USPTO）的数据来计算该指数。然而，这一结果令人困惑，因为美国的创新颠覆性似乎低于欧洲和亚洲国家。我们发现，这种现象主要是由于国际引用数据的缺失所致。通过利用全球引用网络，我们量化并纠正了这一偏差。非美国发明家的创新颠覆性优势下降了64%至148%（相对于美国的基准均值）。美国因此成为全球创新颠覆性的领导者，而亚洲的优势则显著减弱。在全球范围内整合引用数据对于在国际背景下可靠地衡量颠覆性创新至关重要。。

papers.title: Stronger core results with multidimensional prices
papers.abstract: We study one-sided matchings with endowments in the absence of money. It is well-known that a competitive equilibrium may not always exist and that the strong core may be empty in this setting [Hylland and Zeckhauser, 1979]. We propose a generalization of competitive equilibria that associates each item with a multi-dimensional price. We show that this solution concept always exists and resides within the rejective core [Konovalov, 2005]. Rejective core stability is strictly stronger than weak core stability: allocations in the rejective core are elements of the weak core, but the opposite is not true. Moreover, we show that the rejective core always converges to the set of competitive equilibria with multi-dimensional prices as the economy grows, demonstrating core convergence in a setting without non-satiation.
papers.summary_zh: 【金融经济学】我们研究了在不存在货币的情况下，具有禀赋的单边匹配问题。众所周知，在这种环境下，竞争均衡可能并不总是存在，且强核可能为空[Hylland和Zeckhauser，1979]。我们提出了一种竞争均衡的泛化模型，该模型为每件物品赋予一个多维价格。我们证明了这种解决方案总是存在的，并且属于拒绝核[Konovalov，2005]。拒绝核的稳定性严格强于弱核的稳定性：拒绝核中的分配一定是弱核的元素，但反之则不成立。此外，我们还证明了随着经济的发展，拒绝核总会收敛到具有多维价格的竞争均衡集合，从而证明了在不存在非饱和性情况下核的收敛性。。研究方法：均衡模型。

papers.title: Multivariate Residual Estimation Risk
papers.abstract: The purpose of this paper is to describe and extend the use of the newly-introduced measure, residual estimation risk. Following the seminal work of Bignozzi and Tsanakas, the quantification of residual estimation risk is proposed in a multivariate framework. Our aim is to provide a succinct and practical introduction to the concept, to motivate its use as a back-testing measure, and to provide examples related to credit risk parameter estimation. In section 2, we introduce residual estimation risk defined by various risk measures, and illustrate the calculation using R and SAS. In section 3, we propose a back-testing criterion for the measure, which can be altered to assess model performance for both accuracy and conservatism. In section 4, we conduct back-testing on risk parameter estimates of retail credit portfolios, including multiple back-testing measures for comparison. Finally, we conclude our findings and propose areas for future work in section 5.
papers.summary_zh: 【风险管理与衍生品】本文旨在描述并拓展一种新引入的度量方法——残差估计风险（residual estimation risk）的应用。在Bignozzi和Tsanakas的开创性工作基础上，本文提出了在多变量框架中对残差估计风险进行量化的方法。我们的目标是为这一概念提供一个简洁实用的介绍，阐述将其作为回测（back-testing）指标的合理性，并通过实例说明其在信用风险参数估计中的应用。第2节中，我们根据不同的风险度量标准定义了残差估计风险，并使用R和SAS软件演示了其计算方法。第3节提出了该度量的回测标准，该标准可进行调整以评估模型的准确性和保守性。第4节对零售信用组合的风险参数估计进行了回测，并比较了多种不同的回测方法。第5节总结了我们的研究结果，并提出了未来研究的方向。。

papers.title: Wealth Taxes and Post-Growth: How different tax designs align with different goals
papers.abstract: Wealth taxes are a frequently proposed policy within the post-growth literature, but evaluations of their alignment with post-growth goals, and empirical estimates of their potential effects, are lacking. We contribute to this literature by examining the extent to which different wealth-tax designs can contribute to four goals of a post-growth transition: redistributing wealth; eradicating extreme wealth; curbing rent-seeking; and reducing CO2 emissions. The analysis is based on microsimulation modelling, using household-level data from 18 countries of the 2017 EU Household Finance and Consumption Survey. Our analysis finds that taxes on net wealth are the most progressive and redistributive, while taxes on financial and investment property wealth tend to be more effective at addressing rent-seeking. However, we also identify trade-offs and conflicts between different tax designs and goals. As a result, a broader package of policies will be necessary to navigate these conflicts and mitigate the limitations inherent in any single wealth-tax design.
papers.summary_zh: 【金融经济学】财富税是后增长理论中经常被提出的政策工具，但目前尚缺乏对其与后增长目标契合度的评估，以及对其潜在效应的实证研究。我们通过分析不同财富税设计在实现后增长转型四大目标（即财富再分配、消除极端财富差距、遏制寻租行为以及减少二氧化碳排放）方面的作用，为这一研究领域做出了贡献。我们的分析基于微观模拟模型，并使用了2017年欧盟家庭金融与消费调查中18个国家的家庭层面数据。研究发现，对净资产征收的税收具有最高的累进性和再分配效果，而对金融资产和投资性财产征收的税收在遏制寻租行为方面更为有效。然而，我们也发现了不同税收设计与目标之间的权衡与冲突。因此，需要制定一套更为综合的政策体系来协调这些矛盾，并弥补任何单一财富税设计所固有的局限性。。研究方法：调查数据、数值模拟。
